title: TUS Upload-Metadata keys
description: The decoded `Upload-Metadata` keys a client sends when it creates an upload (PROTOCOL.md §4). Values are strings, base64-encoded on the wire. Servers ignore keys they don't recognize.

artifactId.description: The artifact's id. For the video it's the pairing link's `artifactId`; related artifacts use a fresh UUID. Legacy aliases `videoid` and `projectid` are still accepted.

filename.description: Original file name. Its extension must be allowed for `kind` (see `/capabilities`).

relatedTo.description: The artifact this one belongs to: the video, for its captions, beat manifest and thumbnail. A capability token for the video also authorizes artifacts related to it.

checksum.description: `<algorithm>:<hex digest>` of the finished file, verified by servers that check checksums.

name.description: Display title (the draft name), sent on the video. Display-only; servers trim and cap it.

appVersion.description: Since 2.1. Version of the app that uploaded it, e.g. `2.1.0 (45)`. Stored with the artifact. Display-only; servers trim and cap it.
